description:
Asking price £1,800 pcm. The landlord will consider offers between £1,650 and £1,800 pcm. 
This attractive unfurnished one-bedroom, first-floor flat is available to let on Lavender Gardens, a highly sought-after residential road. This property benefits from a large reception room, (approx 21ft x 14ft) with a sash bay window to the front, high ceilings and a fitted kitchen just off the reception room.   At the rear of the property is a large double bedroom with a sash bay window and high ceilings. The property is split-level and forms part of a substantial double-fronted house, offering an appealing living space. The layout provides a comfortable and practical environment for a single occupant or a couple.
The flat is situated in a prime location, providing excellent access to the extensive amenities and transport links of Clapham Junction. Residents will appreciate the short walk to Clapham Common, offering vast green spaces for recreation and relaxation. Additionally, the vibrant areas of Battersea Rise and Northcote Road are just a short stroll away, known for their array of independent shops, cafes, pubs, bars, and restaurants. This immediate access to local conveniences means that many daily needs and leisure activities can be met within the neighbourhood, reducing the need to travel into Central London.
Lavender Gardens itself is a desirable address, known for its attractive properties and convenient position. The area boasts a variety of local gyms and yoga studios, catering to different fitness preferences. The strong community feel and the abundance of local facilities contribute to a high quality of life for residents.
This property is available immediately, with a move-in date no later than 20th September 2026. It is offered unfurnished, allowing tenants to personalise the space to their own taste. Please note that any photos showing furniture are computer generated images to provide an idea of what the space could look like. Clapham Junction train station is only a five minute walk away.
